segment.text: segment {a: [x, y], b: [x, y], length}; a and b in definition order

ray.text: ray {origin: [x, y], dir: [x, y]}; dir is a unit vector from the origin towards the defining point

line.text: line {p: [x, y], dir: [x, y]}; p is the projection of the origin, dir is a unit vector oriented by the definition

polygon.text: polygon {vertices: [[x, y], ...], area}; area is unsigned

vector.text: vector {a: [x, y], b: [x, y], length}; a is the start, b the end; a zero vector is defined

number.text: number {value, unit}; unit is one of numberUnits and compares exactly; angles in radians

angle.text: angle {vertex: [x, y], a0, a1, size} in radians; a0 in [0, 2 pi) is the direction of the first side from +x, size in [0, 2 pi) runs counterclockwise from the first side to the second, a1 = a0 + size

mark.text: mark {kind, count}; kind is one of markKinds, count an integer 1..3, both compare exactly; the geometry of a mark is that of its arguments

angles.normalize: theta = atan2(y, x); theta < 0 gives theta + 2 pi; theta >= 2 pi gives 0; -0 gives 0
angles.convex: the convex measure of an angle is m(size) = size when size <= pi, else 2 pi - size
angles.wrap: a difference of directions wraps into [-pi, pi): wrap(d) = d - 2 pi floor((d + pi) / (2 pi))

segment.text: P = a + t (b - a); t is clamped to [0, 1]

line.text: P = o + t v in the frame of the producer: a line through a and b gives o = a, v = b - a

ray.text: P = o + t v in the frame of the producer; t < 0 is clamped to 0

circle.text: P = c + r (cos t, sin t); t is the angle from +x; projections lie in [0, 2 pi)

polygon.text: t wraps to [0, n); k = floor(t) picks side side.(k + 1), the fraction t - k runs along it

frameKinds.affine: P = o + clamp(t) v; o and v come from frames[producer op], else frames["*"]; min/max clamp t when outside is clamp; a frame expression is a term or a difference of two terms, a term is <src>.<field> (src: value or args) or mid(<term>, <term>), the midpoint of two points
frameKinds.angle: P = c + r (cos t, sin t), t used as given
frameKinds.perimeter: t' = t - n floor(t / n), t' < 0 gives t' + n, t' >= n gives 0; k = floor(t'), f = t' - k; P = V[k] + f (V[(k + 1) mod n] - V[k])

units.length: coordinates and lengths; parity tolerance parity.length * S
units.scalar: dimensionless numbers (unit directions); parity tolerance parity.scalar
units.by_unit: the field kind is numberUnits[value.unit] of the same value
units.exact: a field absent from the value kinds of its type compares exactly
